reason.auto: Best codec for this device and browser, picked at Connect
reason.autoChroma: Sharper takes full colour detail when both ends can do it
reason.chroma420: Colour at quarter resolution — the video default, decodes everywhere
reason.av1: Best quality per bit — hardware on both ends
reason.agentNoAv1: This device has no AV1 hardware encoder
reason.av1NoHw444: No hardware encoder can produce AV1 in 4:4:4
reason.hevc: Hardware H.265 on the device (NVENC / QSV / AMF / VideoToolbox / VAAPI / D3D12 / Vulkan)
reason.hevc444: Sharpest text on the hardware pipeline, ~1.5× bitrate
reason.browserNoHevc: This browser lacks a hardware HEVC decoder
reason.browserNoHevcRext: This browser can’t decode HEVC 4:4:4 (Chrome ≥137 with NVIDIA driver ≥572.16, or Intel Gen11+)
reason.agentNoHevc: This device has no HEVC encoder
reason.agentNoHevc444: This device has no HEVC 4:4:4 encoder (NVENC only today)
reason.browserNoVp9: This browser can’t decode VP9 profile 1
reason.agentNoVp9: This device has no VP9 encoder
reason.h264444: Sharpest text via H.264 High 4:4:4 — hardware encode, software decode
reason.browserNoH264High444: This browser can’t decode H.264 High 4:4:4
reason.agentNoH264_444: This device has no H.264 4:4:4 encoder (NVENC only today)
reason.vp9444hw: Sharpest text, ~1.5× bitrate — hardware encode (Intel), software decode
reason.failedBefore: Failed to decode on this browser earlier — retried after a browser or driver update
reason.no444Anywhere: No 4:4:4 cell exists for this device and browser

endedByHost.title: The person at the device ended the session.
endedByHost.body: They ended it from their screen (Disconnect, or their desktop's own Stop for screen sharing), so this viewer stays disconnected. Reconnect asks them again, as any new session does.

auth.heardAbout: How did you hear about Roomler?
auth.heardAboutHint: Optional. It tells us which channels work.
auth.pairOrgHint: The device you are pairing joins an organization. Create it now, or after you sign in.
auth.orgSlugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes, used in links. Unique on this server.
auth.pairCheckEmail: Registration successful. Please check your email to activate your account.
auth.pairAfterActivation: Then sign in, and you will be brought back to the pairing page. The code in your installer stays valid for 15 minutes; if it ran out, start the pairing again there.

pair.title: Pair a device
pair.signedOutIntro: This connects the installer running on your computer to your account. Sign in or create an account, and you will come back here.
pair.intro: Type the code your installer shows.
pair.notFound: No pending pairing with that code. Check the code in your installer; a pairing lasts 15 minutes, and the installer can start a new one. If this server does not offer pairing, paste a token into your installer instead.
pair.lookupFailed: Could not look up that code. Please try again.
pair.roleDaemon: This computer's remote desktop and private network
pair.halvesTwo: On a Mac the device joins as two entries: one for the screen, one for the private network.
pair.warning: Only approve a device you are setting up right now, in front of you.
pair.warningDetail: If you did not start this install yourself, deny it.
pair.noOrgs: You are not in an organization yet. Create one for the device to join.
pair.orgSlugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes, used in links. Unique on this server.
pair.orgSlugTaken: That short name is already taken. Pick another.
pair.orgCreateFailed: Could not create the organization. Please try again.
pair.approved: Approved — go back to your installer to finish. You can close this tab.
pair.gone: This pairing has expired or was already decided — start again in your installer.
pair.forbiddenDaemon: You cannot approve a device into that organization: it needs the Manage devices permission there. Pick another organization, or ask an administrator.
pair.forbiddenTunnel: You cannot approve a tunnel client into that organization: you are not a member of it.
pair.decideFailed: Could not record your decision. Please try again.

room.name: Room Name
room.noMessages: No messages yet. Start the conversation!

call.blackPicture: Your camera is sending a black picture. Is the lens covered or a privacy shutter closed?

defaultPattern.label: Default pattern
defaultPattern.hint: What a viewer's Keep busy menu pre-selects on a device they have not set it on before. Circle unless you change it; a person's own last choice for a device wins over it.

history.title: History
history.subtitle: Every time keep busy was turned on or off on a device, as the device reported it, and every change to these settings. Kept permanently.

sourceHint.device: What the device itself reported on a heartbeat: a claim, seen at the 30-second heartbeat, never a server decision.
sourceHint.server: The server's own record of an admin's change.

activation.invalidTitle: This activation link is invalid or has expired
activation.invalidText: If your account is already active, just sign in. If not, enter the address you signed up with and we'll send you a new link.
activation.askText: Enter the address you signed up with and we'll send you a new link.

resend.sent: If that address is waiting for activation, a new link is on its way. Check your spam folder too. If nothing arrives, you can ask again in 15 minutes.
resend.throttled: Too many requests from this network. Try again in a few minutes.
resend.error: That didn't go through. Check your connection and try again.

activation.errorText: Nothing was changed. Check your connection and try again.
